optimizations_kept: Inline R61524::TickFrameMark (eliminates 2x out-of-line call + 2x 64-bit modulo % 550000 per SH7305 instruction)
Namespace-scoped cached diagnostic flags (eliminates MSVC function-local static TLS guards on Read/Write/Step)
Direct SDRAM/SystemROM/ILRAM fast-paths in Read8/16/32 and Write8/16/32 (guarded by #ifndef CG50_ENABLE_COVERAGE_COUNTERS)
Cold noinline extraction of HandleAppIfTrap, LogStepDiagnostics and HaltFetchOutOfMap out of StepInstruction() (eliminates wstringstream EH frame & GS stack cookie on hot loop)
before_vs_after_optimization.empirical_lesson_documented: An intermediate experiment inlining RAM/ROM fast-paths into all 6 ExecuteOpcode lambdas caused L1i cache bloat (32 KB I-cache thrash: 15.2 -> 11.6 MIPS 1T) and was reverted after empirical measurement.
